title: Lock Calibration Failed
shortDescription: August lock unable to learn locked/unlocked positions during setup.
fullDescription:
August Smart Locks must calibrate by observing the deadbolt's locked and unlocked positions. If the motor stalls or the deadbolt binds, calibration fails and the app displays an error.

Common causes include a misaligned strike plate, stiff deadbolt, weak batteries, or improper mounting of the lock on the thumbturn.

causes.cause: Misaligned strike plate causing deadbolt bind
Lock mounting plate not tightened properly

fixSteps.title: Test deadbolt manually
fixSteps.instruction: With the door open, turn the thumbturn by hand. It should move freely with light resistance.

fixSteps.title: Replace batteries
fixSteps.instruction: Install four fresh AA lithium or alkaline batteries.

fixSteps.title: Re-run calibration
fixSteps.instruction: In the August app, go to Lock Settings > Calibrate Lock and follow prompts.

whenToCallPro: If deadbolt binds even when lock is removed, a locksmith should adjust the strike plate.
videoSearchQuery: August smart lock calibration failed fix

faq.a: Usually the deadbolt is binding. Align the strike plate so the bolt slides freely.

title: Lock Motor Jammed
shortDescription: August motor detected excessive resistance and stopped.
fullDescription:
The August lock monitors motor current. When the deadbolt meets unusual resistance (door not fully closed, strike misalignment, weak batteries) the motor halts to avoid damage and reports 'Jammed'.

This is a safety feature. Clearing it requires identifying why the bolt cannot throw cleanly.

causes.cause: Door not fully closed when locking attempted
Low batteries unable to drive motor

symptoms: Motor clicks but bolt does not move

fixSteps.title: Close door fully
fixSteps.instruction: Push door firmly against the jamb and retry from the app.

fixSteps.title: Inspect strike plate
fixSteps.instruction: Check if the deadbolt aligns with the strike hole. Enlarge or reposition if needed.

whenToCallPro: If the door itself is warped or sagging, call a carpenter or locksmith.
videoSearchQuery: August smart lock jammed fix strike plate

faq.q: Is jammed bad for the motor?
faq.a: No, the lock stops itself before damage occurs.

title: Bluetooth Connection Error
shortDescription: Phone cannot establish Bluetooth link to the lock.
fullDescription:
August locks use BLE for local control. Connection failures can stem from phone Bluetooth being off, the lock being out of range, or interference.

After a firmware update, the BLE stack occasionally needs a reset via battery pull.

causes.cause: Out of range (>30 ft with walls)

fixSteps.title: Toggle phone Bluetooth
fixSteps.instruction: Turn BT off and on in phone settings.

fixSteps.title: Pull batteries
fixSteps.instruction: Remove lock batteries for 30 seconds and reinsert.

fixSteps.title: Re-open app near door
fixSteps.instruction: Stand within 10 ft and reopen the August app.

whenToCallPro: Rarely needed; contact August support if the issue persists after factory reset.
videoSearchQuery: August lock bluetooth not connecting fix

faq.q: Does the lock need internet to work via Bluetooth?
faq.a: No, BLE works locally without Wi-Fi.

title: Wi-Fi Offline
shortDescription: Lock lost connection to your 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network.
fullDescription:
Wi-Fi equipped August locks (Pro with Connect Bridge, Wi-Fi Smart Lock) must stay on 2.4 GHz. 5 GHz only networks, router changes, or weak signal at the door commonly cause offline status.

Remote control is lost but Bluetooth still works in range.

fixSteps.title: Check Wi-Fi signal
fixSteps.instruction: Stand at the door with your phone. If signal is weak, add a mesh node or extender.

fixSteps.title: Reconnect Wi-Fi
fixSteps.instruction: In the August app, go to Lock Settings > Wi-Fi and reconfigure the 2.4 GHz network.

whenToCallPro: If Wi-Fi coverage at the door is poor, a network installer can add a mesh access point.
videoSearchQuery: August smart lock wifi offline fix

title: Auto-Unlock Feature Fails
shortDescription: Lock does not auto-unlock when you arrive home.
fullDescription:
Auto-Unlock relies on phone geofencing plus Bluetooth proximity. Denied location permissions, battery-saver modes, or disabled Wi-Fi on the phone all break the feature.

The feature also requires that you travel a meaningful distance from the 'home' geofence and return.

causes.cause: Phone battery saver killing background app
Did not leave the home geofence (300 m)

fixSteps.title: Grant 'Always' location
fixSteps.instruction: Phone Settings > Apps > August > Location > Always.

fixSteps.title: Disable battery optimization
fixSteps.instruction: Exclude August from battery saver / background restrictions.

fixSteps.title: Re-enable Auto-Unlock
fixSteps.instruction: Toggle Auto-Unlock off then on in the app.

videoSearchQuery: August auto unlock not working fix

faq.q: How far must I go for Auto-Unlock to arm?

title: Low Battery Warning
fullDescription:
August uses four AA batteries. Lithium lasts 6-12 months, alkaline 3-6 months. Cold weather shortens life significantly.

At ~15 percent the motor may stall even if the level readout looks fine; swap batteries promptly.

fixSteps.title: Install fresh AA batteries
fixSteps.instruction: Use four new lithium AAs; do not mix old and new.

faq.a: Lithium lasts much longer and handles cold better.

title: Smart Keypad Unresponsive
shortDescription: August Smart Keypad buttons do not light or beep.
fullDescription:
The external Smart Keypad runs on three AAA batteries and pairs with the lock over BLE. Dead keypad batteries, loss of BLE pairing, or extreme cold cause lockouts.

Re-pairing from the app usually restores function.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair keypad
fixSteps.instruction: In app: Devices > Keypad > Remove, then add again.

faq.a: No, it pairs over BLE directly to the lock.

title: DoorSense Sensor Calibration
shortDescription: Magnetic door sensor needs to relearn open/closed position.
fullDescription:
DoorSense uses a magnet mounted on the door jamb and a sensor on the lock to distinguish 'closed' from 'open'. If the magnet is moved, the door shifts, or firmware updates, a recalibration prompt appears.

The process takes under two minutes.

fixSteps.title: Run DoorSense setup
fixSteps.instruction: App: Lock Settings > DoorSense > Calibrate. Follow the open/closed prompts.

faq.q: Does DoorSense need a wired sensor?
faq.a: No, it is a magnet; no wiring required.

title: Connect Bridge Offline
shortDescription: August Connect Wi-Fi Bridge lost network connection.
fullDescription:
The August Connect plugs into an outlet and bridges the lock to Wi-Fi. If it loses power, drifts off the 2.4 GHz SSID, or sits too far from the lock, it reports offline.

Move it within 15 feet of the lock for reliable BLE.

causes.cause: Bridge unplugged or outlet switched off

fixSteps.title: Verify power
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm the Connect is plugged in and LED is on.

fixSteps.title: Move closer to lock
fixSteps.instruction: Relocate within 10-15 ft of the door.

faq.q: Do I need the Bridge for the Wi-Fi Smart Lock?
faq.a: No, that model has Wi-Fi built in.

title: HomeKit Pairing or Response Error
shortDescription: Apple Home shows the lock as 'Not Responding'.
fullDescription:
August locks support HomeKit over Bluetooth (some over Wi-Fi via a home hub). Errors occur when the home hub (HomePod/Apple TV) is offline, iCloud sync is broken, or the lock was reset without removing it from the Home app.

Remove and re-add the accessory after confirming the hub is online.

causes.cause: Lock factory-reset but still listed in Home

fixSteps.title: Check home hub
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm HomePod or Apple TV is online in the Home app.

fixSteps.title: Remove and re-add lock
fixSteps.instruction: Remove the lock from Home, then re-add via HomeKit code in the August app.

faq.q: Do I need an Apple TV for HomeKit automations?
faq.a: Yes, for remote access and automations you need a home hub.
